verdict.rationale: Datadog documents an official MCP server and a programmatic API for platform access, which gives an agent a direct path to query the platform. DDSQL or natural-language querying of telemetry is also documented. The pack never shows which tools the MCP server exposes, and the evaluations API is described only for submitting evaluations, not reading them back. Missing for 10: documented MCP/API tools for querying traces and LLM spans, documented metric query endpoints, documented retrieval of eval results, and hands-on corroboration of an agent debugging workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent query my traces, metrics, and eval results through an API or MCP server to debug my app

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://docs.datadoghq.com/mcp_server/
